sourcePriority: This user-adopted 2026-11-07 decision supersedes any older pending/unconfirmed subobjective or three-addon edge-case notes; adopted combat and reward rules otherwise unchanged.

designPolicy.easy: comparatively accessible equipment composition or simple action conditions
designPolicy.normalAndHard: identical secondary-objective conditions; harder enemies/AI already raise hard difficulty

shared.equipment: Evaluate all weapon1/weapon2 slots of three directly controlled units at sortie start; distinct weapon families count once across party; equipped (not merely owned).
shared.percentages: Ratio is remaining current HP divided by stage-defined maximum HP; minimum inclusive; target HP is checked at victory; ceil(maxHP*ratio) is the minimum integer remaining HP.
shared.rounds: Win no later than the stated round, including the last action/round-end of that round.
shared.history: Record relevant objective events (facility damage sources, base occupancy at completed round end, carrier drops) through the whole attempt. Do not reset history on respawn/reconnect; never award after defeat.
shared.rewards: Do not change existing first-subobjective EXP/addon rewards, first-clear/replay EXP, acquisition, stage unlocks or save identity. One-time rewards keep existing idempotency.
shared.failClosed: Until runtime evaluation is implemented and tested, do not guess/auto-grant missing subobjective flags.

existingRulesRetained.trigger: after hostile direct hit, reactor alive and hostile attacker within equipped melee weapon range

newlyAdopted.rounding: floor(sum of actual HP damage directly dealt by this sword counterattack * 0.2)

melee-counter-drive.preserved: Normal-hit-only effects, normal attack hit EN recovery and special railgun surcharge do not trigger on reactions. Other melee reaction weapons unchanged.

existingRulesRetained.landing: empty legal cell directly beyond target

newlyAdopted.rounding: floor(actual target HP damage directly dealt by this sword action * 0.2)
order: commit attack and damage (and normal effects)
resolve enemy counterattack where legally triggered and target alive
only if acting unit remains alive, vault into preselected legal opposite cell
at landing, run existing movement-end reactions including overwatch before thrust interception

blade-vault.preserved: Do not change damage, EN cost, weapon eligibility, movement geometry, legality or normal reaction limit; settled attack is not undone if movement fails.

automaticDefensiveFormations.pair-defense: Consider when AI initiator itself is predicted to take substantial damage. Buff applies to initiator only, not supporters.
automaticDefensiveFormations.protection: Consider when at least two of the three participants are plausibly threatened or one participant faces a likely lethal hit. Buff applies to all three.

newlyAdopted.threatEvaluation: Use only present public/live battlefield state, legal enemy movement/reach and plausible damage; do not assume future enemy actions known.
decisionPriority: prefer beneficial attack or offensive formation when defense value is low
compare EN efficiency and reject needless defensive activation
newlyAdopted.positioning: On its own legal move, AI may prefer a safe position enabling a useful later player/AI formation, but does not move out of turn; explicit player instructions and mission goals take precedence; do not enter lethal exposure or abandon guarded objectives just to form a shape.
newlyAdopted.ui: Reuse existing permission toggle; no additional UI control required.

friendly-ai-formation-enabler.preserved: Keep current pair/protection geometry, effects, buff expiry, EN costs and all five technique constraints. Do not spend directly controlled player EN or action for AI-initiated formations.

persist/reconstruct event history needed for M04/M06/M07 and handle reload/retry
complete only 3 partially connected addon paths with adopted edge rules
typecheck, targeted unit tests, focused smoke and desktop/mobile checks for changed game logic; preserve other systems
doNot: alter other missions/difficulty balance/rewards or art
merge to main or deploy production without explicit instruction
